017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.ini;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.time.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.bean.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.commons.collections.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.marshall.stream.*;
029
030/**
031 * Parses INI-formatted text into POJO models.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Parses INI files (section/key-value format) into Java beans and maps.
035 *
036 * <h5 class='topic'>Media types</h5>
037 * <p>
038 * Consumes: <bc>text/ini, text/x-ini</bc>
039 *
040 * <h5 class='topic'>Value parsing</h5>
041 * <ul class='spaced-list'>
042 *    <li>Unquoted <c>null</c> → Java <jk>null</jk>
043 *    <li>Unquoted <c>true</c>/<c>false</c> → Boolean
044 *    <li>Unquoted numbers → Number (int, long, float, double as appropriate)
045 *    <li>Single-quoted strings (<c>'...'</c>) → String (with <c>''</c> unescaped to single quote)
046 *    <li>Values starting with <c>[</c> or <c>{</c> → Delegated to JSON parser
047 *    <li>ISO 8601 strings → Date, Calendar, or <c>java.time.*</c> when target requires it
048 *    <li>ISO 8601 duration strings → {@link Duration}
049 *    <li>Other unquoted tokens → String
050 * </ul>
051 *
052 * <h5 class='topic'>Sections</h5>
053 * <p>
054 * Sections (e.g. <c>[address]</c>) map to nested bean properties or Map properties.
055 * Section paths like <c>[employment/company]</c> map to deeply nested bean properties.
056 *
057 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
058 * <p class='bjava'>
059 *    <jc>// Parse INI into a bean</jc>
060 *    MyConfig <jv>config</jv> = IniParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>.read(<jv>ini</jv>, MyConfig.<jk>class</jk>);
061 *
062 *    <jc>// Parse into a Map</jc>
063 *    Map&lt;String, Object&gt; <jv>map</jv> = IniParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>.read(<jv>ini</jv>, Map.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, Object.<jk>class</jk>);
064 * </p>
065 *
066 * <h5 class='figure'>Example input:</h5>
067 * <p class='bini'>
068 *    <ck>name</ck> = <cv>Alice</cv>
069 *    <ck>age</ck> = <cv>30</cv>
070 *
071 *    <cs>[address]</cs>
072 *    <ck>street</ck> = <cv>123 Main St</cv>
073 *    <ck>city</ck> = <cv>Boston</cv>
074 *    <ck>state</ck> = <cv>MA</cv>
075 * </p>
076 *
077 * <h5 class='topic'>Limitations</h5>
078 * <p>
079 * Parsing into top-level collections, arrays, or scalar types is not supported.
080 * The target type must be a bean class or <c>Map&lt;String,?&gt;</c>.
081 *
082 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
083 *    <li class='note'>This class is thread safe and reusable.
084 *    <li class='note'>Values starting with <c>[</c> or <c>{</c> are delegated to the JSON parser.
085 * </ul>
086 *
087 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
088 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/Ini">INI Basics</a>
089 * </ul>
090 */
091@SuppressWarnings({
092   "java:S110", "java:S115",
093   "resource" // Closeable resources are owned by the caller's parser session; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
094})
095public class IniParser extends ReaderParser implements IniMetaProvider, RecordReadable {
096
097   private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<ClassMeta<?>,IniClassMeta> iniClassMetas = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
098   private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<BeanPropertyMeta,IniBeanPropertyMeta> iniBeanPropertyMetas = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
099
100   private static final String PROP_kvSeparator = "kvSeparator";
101   private static final String ARG_copyFrom = "copyFrom";
102
103   /**
104    * Builder for {@link IniParser}.
105    */
106   public static class Builder extends ReaderParser.Builder<Builder> {
107
108      private static final Cache<HashKey,IniParser> CACHE = Cache.of(HashKey.class, IniParser.class).build();
109
110      private char kvSeparator = '=';
111
112      protected Builder() {
113         consumes("text/ini,text/x-ini");
114      }
115
116      protected Builder(Builder copyFrom) {
117         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_copyFrom, copyFrom));
118         kvSeparator = copyFrom.kvSeparator;
119      }
120
121      protected Builder(IniParser copyFrom) {
122         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_copyFrom, copyFrom));
123         kvSeparator = copyFrom.kvSeparator;
124      }
125
126      /**
127       * Key-value separator character.
128       *
129       * <p>
130       * By default, the parser recognizes both <c>=</c> and <c>:</c> as key-value separators (matching
131       * {@link IniSerializer.Builder#kvSeparator(char)}'s default of <c>=</c>). Set this to match a
132       * serializer configured with a non-default {@code kvSeparator} so the resulting INI can be
133       * round-tripped.
134       *
135       * @param value The key-value separator character to recognize (in addition to the default <c>=</c>/<c>:</c> pair).
136       * @return This object.
137       */
138      public Builder kvSeparator(char value) {
139         kvSeparator = value;
140         return this;
141      }
142
143      @Override
144      public IniParser build() {
145         return cache(CACHE).build(IniParser.class);
146      }
147
148      @Override
149      public Builder copy() {
150         return new Builder(this);
151      }
152
153      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
154      public HashKey hashKey() {
155         return HashKey.of(super.hashKey(), kvSeparator);
156      }
157   }
158
159   /** Default parser instance. */
160   public static final IniParser DEFAULT = new IniParser(create());
161
162   /**
163    * Creates a new builder.
164    *
165    * @return A new builder.
166    */
167   public static Builder create() {
168      return new Builder();
169   }
170
171   /** Key-value separator. */
172   protected final char kvSeparator;
173
174   /**
175    * Constructor.
176    *
177    * @param builder The builder.
178    */
179   public IniParser(Builder builder) {
180      super(builder);
181      kvSeparator = builder.kvSeparator;
182   }
183
184   @Override
185   public IniBeanPropertyMeta getIniBeanPropertyMeta(BeanPropertyMeta bpm) {
186      if (bpm == null)
187         return IniBeanPropertyMeta.DEFAULT;
188      return iniBeanPropertyMetas.computeIfAbsent(bpm, k -> new IniBeanPropertyMeta(k, this));
189   }
190
191   @Override
192   public IniClassMeta getIniClassMeta(ClassMeta<?> cm) {
193      return iniClassMetas.computeIfAbsent(cm, k -> new IniClassMeta(k, this));
194   }
195
196   @Override
197   public IniParserSession.Builder createSession() {
198      return IniParserSession.create(this);
199   }
200
201   @Override
202   public Builder copy() {
203      return new Builder(this);
204   }
205
206   @Override
207   protected FluentMap<String,Object> properties() {
208      return super.properties()
209         .a(PROP_kvSeparator, String.valueOf(kvSeparator));
210   }
211
212   /**
213    * Convenience delegator that opens a {@link RecordReader} over the input using
214    * <b>default session arguments</b> (mirrors {@link #read(Object, Class)}).
215    *
216    * <p>
217    * The real implementation lives on {@link IniParserSession#readRecords(Object)}.  Callers
218    * that need request-derived configuration (locale, timezone, schema, swaps) should call
219    * {@link #createSession()} and invoke {@link IniParserSession#readRecords(Object)} on the
220    * built session instead.
221    *
222    * @param input The input.
223    * @return A new {@link RecordReader} cursor.
224    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying input.
225    */
226   @Override /* RecordReadable */
227   public RecordReader readRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
228      return ((RecordReadable) getSession()).readRecords(input);
229   }
230
231   @Override /* RecordReadable */
232   public boolean isRecordStreaming() {
233      return false;
234   }
235}
